recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，已先圈選 CD19+ B 細胞：單一大族群 CD20 表現約在 10^4–10^5，CD38 從陰性延伸到約 10^4，呈異質性部分陽性，用來評估 CLL 的 CD38 預後標記。
features: Flow cytometry dot plot gated on CD19-positive B cells, CD20-PC7 (x-axis) versus CD38-PC5.5 (y-axis)
Single dominant B-cell cluster with CD20 expression spanning roughly 10^4 to 10^5 (dim-to-moderate, relatively homogeneous)
CD38 expression heterogeneous, ranging from negative (<10^3) up to about 10^4-10^5, with a substantial fraction above the negative region
describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot gated on CD19-positive B cells displays CD20 versus CD38. The B cells form a single dominant population with dim-to-moderate CD20 and a continuous, heterogeneous CD38 expression spanning negative to positive intensities, so that a considerable proportion of the clone appears CD38 positive. The exact percentage cannot be read from the plot without quadrant statistics. In the setting of CLL, CD38 positivity in at least 30% of the clone is an adverse prognostic marker, and brighter CD20 is often seen in CLL with trisomy 12.
